SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM iam_user_role ur
JOIN iam_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN iam_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN iam_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ur.expires_at IS NULL OR ur.expires_at > now()) AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rp.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_code, m.menu_name, m.scope, m.path, m.route_name, m.component_key, m.required_permission_code, m.sort_order FROM iam_user_role ur
JOIN iam_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN iam_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.id JOIN iam_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id JOIN iam_permission p ON p.permission_code = m.required_permission_code LEFT JOIN iam_menu_feature mf ON mf.menu_id = m.id LEFT JOIN iam_tenant_feature tf ON tf.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND tf.feature_code = mf.feature_code WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ur.expires_at IS NULL OR ur.expires_at > now()) AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rm.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.required_permission_code IN
#{permissionCode}
AND ( mf.feature_code IS NULL OR ( tf.enabled = TRUE AND (tf.effective_from IS NULL OR tf.effective_from <= now()) AND (tf.effective_to IS NULL OR tf.effective_to > now()) ) ) ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.menu_code ASC

SELECT r.default_menu_code FROM iam_user_role ur
JOIN iam_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ur.expires_at IS NULL OR ur.expires_at > now()) AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.default_menu_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.id ASC

FROM iam_menu m LEFT JOIN iam_menu_feature mf ON mf.menu_id = m.id LEFT JOIN iam_tenant_feature tf ON tf.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tf.feature_code = mf.feature_code WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY m.id, m.menu_code, m.menu_name, m.scope, m.path, m.route_name, m.component_key, m.icon, m.required_permission_code, m.sort_order, m.status, m.system_builtin ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.menu_code ASC

FROM iam_role r JOIN iam_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.id JOIN iam_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN iam_menu_feature mf ON mf.menu_id = m.id LEFT JOIN iam_tenant_feature tf ON tf.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND tf.feature_code = mf.feature_code WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.id = #{roleId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND rm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rm.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY m.id, m.menu_code, m.menu_name, m.scope, m.path, m.route_name, m.component_key, m.icon, m.required_permission_code, m.sort_order, m.status, m.system_builtin ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.menu_code ASC

INSERT INTO iam_notification_outbox (tenant_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, template_code, recipient, payload_json, delivery_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, 'IAM_USER_INVITATION', #{invitationId}, 'USER_ACTIVATION', #{recipient}, #{payloadJson}, 'QUEUED', now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.tenant_id, n.aggregate_id, n.recipient, n.payload_json FROM iam_notification_outbox n JOIN iam_user_invitation i ON i.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND i.id = n.aggregate_id WHERE n.aggregate_type = 'IAM_USER_INVITATION' AND i.status = 'PENDING' AND i.expires_at > now() AND n.attempts < 5 AND ( n.delivery_status = 'QUEUED' OR (n.delivery_status = 'FAILED' AND n.updated_at < now() - make_interval(mins => CAST(power(2, n.attempts) AS integer))) OR (n.delivery_status = 'PROCESSING' AND n.updated_at < now() - interval '10 minutes') ) ORDER BY n.created_at ASC, n.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_notification_outbox SET delivery_status = 'PROCESSING', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND attempts < 5 AND ( delivery_status = 'QUEUED' OR (delivery_status = 'FAILED' AND updated_at < now() - make_interval(mins => CAST(power(2, attempts) AS integer))) OR (delivery_status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < now() - interval '10 minutes') ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_user_invitation i WHERE i.tenant_id = iam_notification_outbox.tenant_id AND i.id = iam_notification_outbox.aggregate_id AND i.status = 'PENDING' AND i.expires_at > now() )

UPDATE iam_notification_outbox SET delivery_status = 'DELIVERED', attempts = attempts + 1, payload_json = '{}', last_error = NULL, delivered_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND delivery_status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE iam_notification_outbox SET delivery_status = 'FAILED', attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND delivery_status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE iam_notification_outbox n SET delivery_status = 'EXPIRED', payload_json = '{}', last_error = NULL, updated_at = now() FROM iam_user_invitation i WHERE n.aggregate_type = 'IAM_USER_INVITATION' AND n.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND n.aggregate_id = i.id AND i.expires_at <= now() AND n.payload_json <> '{}'

UPDATE iam_notification_outbox SET delivery_status = CASE WHEN delivery_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN delivery_status ELSE #{terminalStatus} END, payload_json = '{}', last_error = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND aggregate_type = 'IAM_USER_INVITATION' AND aggregate_id = #{invitationId} AND payload_json <> '{}'
mapper.select: SELECT i.id invitation_id, i.user_id, i.email, i.status, i.expires_at, i.created_at, COALESCE(n.delivery_status, 'NOT_QUEUED') delivery_status, COALESCE(n.attempts, 0) delivery_attempts, n.last_error delivery_error FROM iam_user_invitation i LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT delivery_status, attempts, last_error FROM iam_notification_outbox WHERE aggregate_type = 'IAM_USER_INVITATION' AND aggregate_id = i.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_user_invitation SET token_digest = #{tokenDigest}, status = 'PENDING', expires_at = #{expiresAt}, accepted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{invitationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE iam_user_invitation SET status = 'REVOKED', updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{invitationId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE iam_user SET status = 'DISABLED', updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING_ACTIVATION' AND deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.update: UPDATE iam_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, status = 'ACTIVE', updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING_ACTIVATION' AND deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT count(DISTINCT m.menu_code) FROM iam_role_menu rm JOIN iam_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN iam_menu_feature mf ON mf.menu_id = m.id LEFT JOIN iam_tenant_feature tf ON tf.tenant_id = rm.tenant_id AND tf.feature_code = mf.feature_code WHERE rm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND rm.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.menu_code = #{menuCode} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( mf.feature_code IS NULL OR ( tf.enabled = TRUE AND (tf.effective_from IS NULL OR tf.effective_from <= now()) AND (tf.effective_to IS NULL OR tf.effective_to > now()) ) )
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_menu SET menu_name = #{name}, path = #{path}, route_name = #{routeName}, component_key = #{componentKey}, icon = #{icon}, required_permission_code = #{requiredPermissionCode}, sort_order = #{sort}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{menuId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_menu_feature (menu_id, feature_code, created_at) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{featureCode}, now()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_tenant_feature SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND feature_code = #{featureCode}

mapper.update: UPDATE iam_role_permission SET deleted_at = now(), updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role_id = #{roleId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_role_permission (tenant_id, role_id, permission_id, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, version) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{roleId}, p.id, now(), #{actorId}, now(), #{actorId}, 0 FROM iam_permission p WHERE p.permission_code = #{permissionCode} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, role_id, permission_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_role SET default_menu_code = #{defaultMenuCode}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{roleId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT acl.id, acl.tenant_id, acl.resource_type, acl.resource_id, acl.subject_type, acl.subject_id, acl.permission_code, acl.effect, acl.expires_at FROM iam_resource_acl acl LEFT JOIN iam_user_role ur ON acl.subject_type = 'role' AND ur.role_id = acl.subject_id AND ur.tenant_id = acl.tenant_id AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ur.expires_at IS NULL OR ur.expires_at > now()) LEFT JOIN iam_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = acl.tenant_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE acl.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND acl.resource_type = #{resourceType} AND acl.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND acl.permission_code = #{permissionCode} AND acl.deleted_at IS NULL AND (acl.expires_at IS NULL OR acl.expires_at > now()) AND ( (acl.subject_type = 'user' AND acl.subject_id = #{userId}) OR (acl.subject_type = 'role' AND r.id IS NOT NULL) )

SELECT acl.subject_id FROM iam_resource_acl acl JOIN iam_user u ON acl.subject_type = 'user' AND u.id = acl.subject_id AND u.tenant_id = acl.tenant_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE acl.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND acl.resource_type = #{resourceType} AND acl.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND acl.permission_code = #{permissionCode} AND lower(acl.effect) = 'allow' AND acl.deleted_at IS NULL AND (acl.expires_at IS NULL OR acl.expires_at > now()) UNION SELECT ur.user_id FROM iam_resource_acl acl JOIN iam_role r ON acl.subject_type = 'role' AND r.id = acl.subject_id AND r.tenant_id = acl.tenant_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN iam_user_role ur ON ur.tenant_id = acl.tenant_id AND ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ur.expires_at IS NULL OR ur.expires_at > now()) JOIN iam_user u ON u.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND u.id = ur.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE acl.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND acl.resource_type = #{resourceType} AND acl.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND acl.permission_code = #{permissionCode} AND lower(acl.effect) = 'allow' AND acl.deleted_at IS NULL AND (acl.expires_at IS NULL OR acl.expires_at > now())
